h0_contemporaneous.economic_interpretation: Do not reject H0: Wholesale gasoline prices adjust symmetrically to crude shocks within 24h.

h0_cumulative.economic_interpretation: Do not reject H0: Cumulative transmission of crude shocks is symmetric across a 2-day window.

h0_joint_nested.hypothesis: H0^(joint): beta_0+ = beta_0- AND beta_1+ = beta_1- (M3 nests M2)
h0_joint_nested.economic_interpretation: Do not reject H0: Linear dynamic model M2 is an adequate representation; asymmetry is not supported.
